newsitem.title: BULGARIA: NO DEALS ON BULGARIA STOCK MARKET, RABSI UNCHANGED.
newsitem.headline: NO DEALS ON BULGARIA STOCK MARKET, RABSI UNCHANGED.

text.p: The RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Friday's all-time low of 40.61 points as there were no deals in corporate paper on local bourses, brokers said.

United Bulgarian bank shares were offered at par of 1,000 levs on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE) but there no bidders. Biohimbank shares were also offered there at 580 levs, below the par of 1 000 but no bids were received.

Varna Grand Hotel stocks were bid at 82 levs on the BSE but no one offered, traders said. Bulgarleasing shares were also bid there at 1,100 levs against par of 1,000 but there were no shares on offer.
There were no offers or demand for corporate stocks on the Sofia Stock Exchange and no repo deals in treasury paper either.
